errors_encountered.solution: Use inline style={{ maxWidth: 340 }} for layout-critical constraints.

decisions_made.decision: Use inline styles for specific numeric layout constraints (max-width) to bypass JIT dynamic detection issues.
decisions_made.reason: Tailwind arbitrary values in template literals often fail to generate classes.
